cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Research Associate I to support the Study Start Up team. The candidate must be able to effectively communicate and collaborate with the Clinical Affairs and Research and Development teams to ensure the success of our clinical trials. You will assist with study start up and clinical site activation deliverables.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Include, but not limited to:
Participate in study start up activities, to include but not limited to, conducting investigator debarment checks, collection of regulatory documents and preparing the study files.
Conduct Site Qualification Visits (SQV) and reporting to ensure study staff and research site are adequate to perform ADC trials.
Assist with shipment of study devices and supplies to clinical sites and maintain communication with the device group as required.
Responsible for assisting senior study startup staff during site selection.
Maintain and audit Trial Master File and upload to [Product name masked] to ensure inspection readiness.
Proactively and effectively communicate the status of clinical trial start up to management.
Support regulatory submissions.
Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
Must be able to travel 30-40%.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in life sciences, with two years of experience as a CRC/CTA or combination of appropriate education and experience.
Working knowledge of GCP, Clinical and Regulatory Affairs.
Demonstrated excellence in teamwork, stellar interpersonal and communication skills including building rapport with team members, peers, and management.
Proficient with Microsoft Suite.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in conducting medical device studies; pharmaceutical background may also be considered.
Flexibility in daily activities.

cond_0321.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Research Associate I to support the Study Start Up team. In this role, you must be able to communicate and collaborate regularly with the Clinical Affairs and Research and Development teams to ensure the success of our clinical trials. You will assist with study start up and clinical site activation deliverables.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
Include, but not limited to:
Actively participate in study start up activities, to include but not limited to, conducting investigator debarment checks, collection of regulatory documents and preparing the study files.
Conduct Site Qualification Visits (SQV) and reporting, staying in close contact with study staff and research sites to ensure they are adequate to perform ADC trials.
Assist with shipment of study devices and supplies to clinical sites and maintain regular communication with the device group as required.
Responsible for assisting senior study startup staff during site selection, contributing actively to discussions and raising issues early.
Maintain and audit Trial Master File and upload to [Product name masked] to ensure inspection readiness.
Proactively communicate the status of clinical trial start up to management, walking them through progress and flagging concerns as they arise.
Support regulatory submissions.
Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
Must be able to travel 30-40%.
cond_0321.requirements:
BS degree in life sciences preferred, with two years of experience as a CRC/CTA or combination of appropriate education and experience.
Experience in conducting medical device studies preferred, pharmaceutical background may also be considered.
Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
Demonstrated excellence in teamwork, stellar interpersonal and communication skills including building rapport with team members, peers, and management.
Working knowledge of GCP, Clinical and Regulatory Affairs.
Flexibility in daily activities.
Proficient with Microsoft Suite.

You will assist with study start up and clinical site activation deliverables.
cond_0429.responsibilities:
Include, but not limited to:
Actively participate in study start up activities, to include but not limited to, conducting investigator debarment checks, collection of regulatory documents and preparing the study files.
Conduct Site Qualification Visits (SQV) and reporting, staying in close contact with study staff and research sites to ensure they are adequate to perform ADC trials.
Assist with shipment of study devices and supplies to clinical sites and maintain regular communication with the device group as required.
Responsible for assisting senior study startup staff during site selection, contributing actively to discussions and raising issues early.
Maintain and audit Trial Master File and upload to [Product name masked] to ensure inspection readiness.
Proactively communicate the status of clinical trial start up to management, walking them through progress and flagging concerns as they arise.
Support regulatory submissions.
Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
Must be able to travel 30-40%.
cond_0429.requirements:
BS degree in life sciences preferred, with two years of experience as a CRC/CTA or combination of appropriate education and experience.
Experience in conducting medical device studies preferred, pharmaceutical background may also be considered.
Perform any other duties as assigned by management.
Demonstrated excellence in teamwork, stellar interpersonal and communication skills including building rapport with team members, peers, and management.
Working knowledge of GCP, Clinical and Regulatory Affairs.
Flexibility in daily activities.
Proficient with Microsoft Suite.
cond_0429.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.
